description: This file defines a class 'JsonRpcParser' responsible for parsing JSON-RPC responses within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles specific parsing logic for JSON-RPC protocol, including processing of response streams, extracting operation output, and event stream handling.

classes.name: JsonRpcParser
classes.description: A class implementing JSON-RPC response parsing for AWS SDK, inheriting from AbstractParser and including PayloadParserTrait. Handles parsing responses according to JSON-RPC protocol, including event stream responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with an API service description and optional JSON parser instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes parsing of a response for a given command, returning the result.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a response based on JSON-RPC protocol, handling output shape and event streams.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a member from a response stream using the embedded JSON parser.
